product_overview: Backend-focused PRD to demonstrate end-to-end authentication flows using TestSprite: includes health check, dev-only E2E login that sets an httpOnly session cookie, and protected route enforcement.
core_goals: Provide a reliable health-check endpoint for automated test readiness (GET /status).
Support dev-only E2E login to establish httpOnly cookie-based sessions (POST /auth/e2e/login).
Enforce authentication on protected endpoints and validate session behavior (GET /auth/me and other protected APIs).
Document happy-path and error flows for CI/E2E test automation.
Keep frontend and agent logic out of scope; focus on backend API behavior and session cookies.

features.name: Status Endpoint
features.description: Public health check endpoint used by tests and monitoring to verify server availability.
user_flows: GET /status when server unreachable -> Receive network error / timeout (no HTTP response)

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Dev-only E2E login to create httpOnly cookie sessions and a protected /auth/me endpoint that returns the current user when authenticated.
user_flows: POST /auth/e2e/login with body { "id": "e2e_user_1", "email": "e2e@test.local", "name": "E2E User" } -> Receive 200 { "ok": true, "message": "E2E login successful" } and httpOnly session cookie set -> GET /auth/me with session cookie -> Receive 200 { "user": { "id": "e2e_user_1", "email": "e2e@test.local", "name": "E2E User" } }
POST /auth/e2e/login with body { "id": "e2e_user_1", "email": "e2e@test.local", "name": "E2E User" } when E2E mode is disabled -> Receive 404 { "error": "E2E test mode is not enabled" }

features.name: Protected API - Support Run
features.description: Representative protected backend operation (used in tests to assert auth gating). Requires authenticated session cookie to run.
user_flows: POST /auth/e2e/login with body { "id": "e2e_user_1", "email": "e2e@test.local", "name": "E2E User" } -> Receive 200 { "ok": true } and httpOnly session cookie set -> POST /api/support/run with session cookie -> Receive 200 (operation accepted)

features.name: Authentication
features.description: User authentication with Scalekit and session management
